say:1:1536110001:1.text: How was I supposed to know the Hunting Goddess would awaken this year?
say:1:1536110001:1.source_cn: 我哪知道狩猎神大人今年会苏醒呀。
say:1:1536110001:1.male: How was I supposed to know the Hunting Goddess would awaken this year?
say:1:1536110001:1.female: How was I supposed to know the Hunting Goddess would awaken this year?

say:2:1536110002:1.text: They wouldn't even let me join the tryout. Said my child's about to be born.
say:2:1536110002:1.source_cn: 他们连选拔赛都不让我参加，巫祭说我的孩子这两天就会出生了。
say:2:1536110002:1.male: They wouldn't even let me join the tryout. Said my child's about to be born.
say:2:1536110002:1.female: They wouldn't even let me join the tryout. Said my child's about to be born.

say:3:1536110003:1.text: But it's alright. Next time the Bloodhunt comes around, my kid'll be old enough to join!
say:3:1536110003:1.source_cn: 但没关系。等下次猎血节，我的孩子应该就有资格参加了！
say:3:1536110003:1.male: But it's alright. Next time the Bloodhunt comes around, my kid'll be old enough to join!
say:3:1536110003:1.female: But it's alright. Next time the Bloodhunt comes around, my kid'll be old enough to join!
